$comment: Built from the clone's src/App.jsx render order and src/components/*, cross-checked against CLONE_SPEC.md (Playwright recon of the live site). Structure only — no original site copy is recorded here.

meta.source: https://typewave.blendmodes.com/ (local React clone in this folder)

categories.CHROME: Persistent page furniture rendered outside <main>: top navigation and footer.
categories.HERO: Page-opening block above and just below the fold.
categories.FEATURES: Product explanation modules showing what the plugin generates and how.
categories.COMMERCE: Plans, prices and checkout entry points.
categories.SUPPORT: Question-and-answer content that resolves buyer objections.
categories.CONVERSION: Lead capture and persistent call-to-action surfaces outside the main narrative.
categories.OVERLAY: Pointer-following or fixed UI layered over the page, not part of the document flow.

chrome.navbar.description: Fixed 88px top bar (80px on mobile): brand mark, three in-page anchor links, and a Figma call-to-action button. Hides on scroll-down past 80px and returns on scroll-up; collapses to a hamburger with a full-height overlay menu at 1024px and below.
chrome.navbar.scope: Present on the single route (/), rendered before <main>.

hero.product-intro.description: Centered three-line display-1 headline (last line in the brand colour), a short subtitle and a Figma button, followed by a product demo video that peeks above the fold and scales from 0.8 to 1 as the page scrolls; the video plays once on scroll-down and rewinds on exit.

features.how-it-works-stack.description: Three-step explainer: a parallax section header above three sticky full-width video cards that scale between 0.75 and 1 as each arrives and is covered by the next; each card's video starts once it reaches 0.98 scale. Plain stacked autoplaying cards on mobile.
features.how-it-works-stack.scope: Second block of <main> on the single route (/), anchor target #how-it-works.

features.figma-organization-cards.description: Three image cards showing the Figma artefacts the plugin creates (frames, text styles, variables), laid out as a 3-column grid on desktop and a horizontal swipe carousel at 1024px and below.
features.figma-organization-cards.scope: Third block of <main> on the single route (/).

features.breakpoint-scrub.description: Tall scroll stage (100vh + 400px) with a sticky device mockup that morphs desktop → tablet → phone across the middle 60% of its scroll, two captions that slide up over the second half, and an interactive type-size simulator panel. The mockup is an HTML/CSS rebuild; the original Lottie is not reused.
features.breakpoint-scrub.scope: Fourth block of <main> on the single route (/).

features.preset-folders.description: Row of coloured preset folder icons (12 / 8 / 5 per desktop / tablet / mobile) with a single sine-wave lift that travels left to right as the section scrolls through view.
features.preset-folders.scope: Fifth block of <main> on the single route (/).

features.export-cards.description: Two side-by-side cards, each a screenshot plus title and paragraph, covering the CSS export and the AI-prompt export (the second card carries id ai-prompt).
features.export-cards.scope: Sixth block of <main> on the single route (/).

commerce.pricing-plans.description: Section title, three plan cards (two with checkout links, one enterprise mailto) each split by a 12px notched 'ticket' seam between price and button, then an 'everything included' feature list with one tagged item.
commerce.pricing-plans.scope: Seventh block of <main> on the single route (/), anchor target #pricing.

support.faq-accordion.description: Two-column FAQ: a sticky lead column (title, contact link, illustration) whose top offset moves between 120px and 32px with the navbar, beside a single-open accordion list with rotating chevrons.
support.faq-accordion.scope: Eighth block of <main> on the single route (/), anchor target #faq.

conversion.newsletter-signup.description: Centered title, short text and an email field with an inline submit button that posts to an external newsletter endpoint in a new tab.
conversion.newsletter-signup.scope: Last block of <main> on the single route (/).

chrome.footer.description: Large closing title with the brand logo and a Figma button, then a bottom row with copyright and legal links.
chrome.footer.scope: Present on the single route (/), rendered after <main>.

conversion.floating-cta.description: Fixed bottom-centre pill holding a Figma button; slides in only while the navbar is hidden, the hero video has scrolled past, and the newsletter is not yet in view.
conversion.floating-cta.scope: Rendered after the footer on the single route (/).

overlay.type-inspector.description: Small monospace badge that follows the mouse and names the type-scale class of the text under the cursor; fine-pointer devices only, hidden on scroll.
overlay.type-inspector.scope: Mounted last on the single route (/).
